text.text:
I suddenly had a craving for cake, and after searching on Google, I found a place right next to my house. The cakes were made with really high-quality ingredients, but unfortunately, the tiramisu I wanted was sold out. It's rare to find a place like this in Nangang; being able to eat something delicious was a small but precious joy!

The minimum spend is NT$200 per person, and children under 12 are not allowed to enter.

originalText.text:
忽然很想吃蛋糕，用google搜尋之後發現在住家旁邊而已，蛋糕真的真材實料，可惜想吃的提拉米蘇賣完了，在南港真的很少有這種商家，能吃到美味真的是小確幸！
一個人低消是200元，商家不招待12歲以下的小孩喔！

text.text:
I couldn't resist putting down my utensils halfway through my meal to give it a thumbs up!

The aroma of bread wafted in as soon as I entered.

It was my favorite flavor, "Potato with Meat Sauce."

I wanted to buy it, but it was only available by pre-order.

(I managed to get it in the end, I was so happy I could fly! The owner said there were two extra, super lucky 💖)

Customers who want to try the bread should follow them on Line!

-
This is truly a very kind cat cafe.

The food is amazing! The braised pork with prunes and the Hungarian beef were incredibly delicious. Despite inflation and rising prices, there's no service charge, and you can even charge your phone. With this level of quality, it's definitely worth supporting with New Taiwan Dollars.

I personally agree with the cafe's policy of "not accepting children under 12."

After all, too many parents are just there to have fun.

There are so many unruly children and difficult parents... As a pet owner, of course I have to protect my furry friend.

By the way, it's not surprising to see cat hair in a cat cafe. It seems like a family-run business. There's really no need to comment on the staff. The auntie was very friendly. The minimum spend of NT$200 plus extra rice is definitely worth it!

Keep up the good work, boss lady and her family! 💖

originalText.text:
吃到一半忍不住放下餐具先來給肯定

一進門聞到撲鼻的麵包香
是我喜歡的口味「肉醬馬鈴薯」
本想購買沒想到是預訂才有
（最後還是買到了，開心到原地起飛，闆娘說有多兩顆，超級幸運💖）

想試試麵包的客人要加line 關注喔

-

這真的是很佛心的一間貓咖

食物更是讓人驚艷
梅干燉小豬、匈牙利牛肉都好吃到爆
通膨、物料漲不收服務費還可以充電
有這樣的水準真的要好好用新台幣支持

個人認同店家「不接受12歲以下孩子」
畢竟太多家長只是為了耍廢

刁蠻的孩子&恐龍家長這麼多..
身為毛孩的家長當然要保護自己的毛孩

Bytheway
貓咖有貓毛真沒什麼好大驚小怪
看起來就是家庭式經營
真的也不需要說店員怎樣
阿姨非常親切～
只能說低消200還可以加飯非常值得！

老闆娘一家人加油💖
